{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Time in a Bottle|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Zilean |skill = I |icon = Time in a Bottle.png |blurb = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Zilean}} generates a storage of {{sti|{{as|experience}}}} over time. When he has enough to level up an allied {{tip|champion}}, he can {{tip|channel}} by {{RMB}}selecting them to split the stored {{sti|{{as|experience}}}} between himself and the ally. |description = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Zilean''' generates {{sti|Experience|{{as|{{pp|2;3.5;5;6;12|1;6;11;16;18}} experience}}}} (does not count towards his own [[Experience (champion)|level up]]) every 5 seconds. ''Time in a Bottle'' is on cooldown when the game starts and becomes disabled when '''Zilean''' and his allied champions have reached their {{tt|maximum level|On Summoner's Rift, level 20 for the champion in the top lane role and 18 for Zilean and all other allies.}}. |description2 = When he has stored enough to level up an allied {{tip|champion}} and grant the same amount of {{as|experience}} to himself, he can {{tt|select them|Default MB2/right-click}} to {{tip|channel}} for {{fd|1.2}} seconds after a {{fd|0.5}}-second [[cast time]].

The channel is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} and disabled upon entering [[combat status|combat]] with enemy champions or taking damage from {{tip|turret|turrets}}, placing it on a {{sti|10-second cooldown}}. If '''Zilean''' interrupts it himself, it is placed on a 1-second cooldown, increased to 2 if he used a [[basic attack]] against a turret to do so. Additionally, if '''Zilean''' becomes affected by any form of {{tip|crowd control}}, the channel is placed on a 10-second cooldown. |description3 = A successful channel will grant an equal amount of {{as|experience}} to the ally to-level-up and '''Zilean''', with a combined minimum of 15% of the stored {{as|experience}}. |description4 = '''''Zilean''' cannot initiate the channel while he is affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}} or a {{tip|lockout}} that disables abilities.'' |target range = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 875 |static = {{tt|120|Starts post-effect}} |targeting = Unit |affects = Allies |silence = true |notes = * ''Time in a Bottle'' marks allied champions with two circles beneath them; the inner one represents how close they are to leveling up, turning golden when able to activate ''Time in a Bottle'' on them. * The target allied champion is not required to be out of combat to be leveled up by ''Time in a Bottle'' - only '''Zilean''' is. * '''Zilean''' only consumes the amount of {{sti|{{as|experience}}}} required to level up an allied champion. He retains the excess for later use. * The target allied champion is not required to be within range of '''Zilean''' for the channel to complete successfully, it will complete regardless of if they move to a far distance. * The channel from ''Time in a Bottle'' is not interrupted even if the allied champion suddenly levels up. However, no experience will be granted to either player, and the passive will not go on cooldown. * The following table refers for interactions while '''Zilean''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}}: {{ct|channel|attack=interrupts|cast=interrupts|move=interrupts|items=interrupts,true,,false|consume=true|spells=true, interrupts, interrupts, interrupts, interrupts|interrupts=death, silence}} }}

{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Time Bomb|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Zilean
|skill        = Q
|icon         = Time Bomb.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Zilean}} throws a ticking time bomb to the target location that will attach upon enemy contact, {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them. It will detonate after a short time or when the attached unit dies, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies hit.
|blurb2      = The bomb will detonate immediately if another bomb attaches to the same target, briefly {{tip|stun|stunning}} enemies hit.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zilean''' throws a ticking time bomb to the target location that briefly grants {{tip|sight}} of its {{tt|surroundings|Cannot grant sight through terrain and can only grant sight into brush when the missile flies through that brush}} as it travels as well as while lingering in the area. The bomb will attach itself to units that move within the epicenter, or those hit directly at the time of the bomb's landing, {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them and their surroundings.
|leveling2    = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|75|115|165|230|300}} {{as|(+ 90% AP)}}}}
|description2 = {{tt|After 3 seconds|From when the bomb lands}}, or when the attached unit dies, the bomb explodes to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
|description3 = The bomb detonates immediately if another bomb attaches itself to the same unit, {{tip|stun|stunning}} nearby enemies for a duration.
|leveling3    = {{st|Stun Duration|{{ap|1.1 to 1.5}} seconds}}
|target range = 900
|effect radius= {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|350|Explosion radius}}|{{tip|sight|icononly=true}}{{tt|500|Missile sight radius while in flight}}}}
|collision radius = {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 140
|cooldown     = {{ap|10 to 8}}
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|cost         = {{ap|60 to 80}}
|costtype     = Mana
|targeting    = Location
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = spellaoe
|projectile   = True
|outofrange   = walk to location
|notes        = 
* ''Time Bombs'' landing directly on top of multiple units follow a priority order for whom to attach themselves to.
*# Units already carrying a bomb
*# Enemy champions
*# Allied champions
*# Enemy minions
*# Allied minions
* ''Time Bombs'' are not visible to enemies if they attach to an ally that is {{tip|stealth|stealthed}} and vice versa.
* When ''Time Bomb'' snaps onto an enemy, it  deals 0 {{tip|proc damage}}.
** This triggers [[combat status|in-combat]] effects such as drawing turret aggro and drawing [[Monster#Monster_Behavior|monster aggression]].
** It also triggers {{ri|Sudden Impact}} and applies {{ii|Elixir of Sorcery}}.
** It does not trigger {{ri|Cheap Shot}}, however, as {{tip|proc damage}} doesn't trigger {{ri|Cheap Shot}}.
* '''Zilean''' can detonate an enemy counterpart's ''Time Bomb'' by placing his own on the same unit (the first bomb still deals damage).
* ''Time Bomb'' will be dispelled if the holder takes fatal damage and is saved by {{tip|resurrection}} before it explodes.
* ''Time Bomb'' can deal damage to the enemy holder through {{tip|untargetable|untargetablility}}.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will prevent the application of ''Time Bomb'' and its detonation damage as well as block the {{tip|stun}}, but not its immediate detonation if the target already has a ''Time Bomb'' on them.
* While {{ai|Inherent Glamour|Neeko|disguised}} as a non-champion, {{ci|Neeko}} cannot be affected by ''Time Bomb''.{{bug}}
}}

{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Garden of Thorns|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Zyra
|skill        = I
|icon         = Garden of Thorns.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Zyra}} {{as|Seeds|buzzword2}} can be turned into plants by hitting them with her basic abilities. Enemy {{tip|champions}} can step over a {{as|Seed|buzzword2}} to destroy it.
|blurb2      = {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Zyra''' plants one or two {{as|Seeds|buzzword2}} nearby that remain for some time.
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Zyra''' spawns one or two {{as|Seeds|buzzword2}} nearby that last for 30 seconds, granting {{tip|sight}} over the surrounding area for 1 second.
|static       = {{pp|13.6 - (13.6-9.05)/17*(x-1) for 20}} 
|description2 = After 1 second, enemy {{tip|champions}} can destroy ''Seeds'' by moving on top of them.
|description3 = '''Zyra''' can only have a total of 8 ''Seeds'' planted at a time, preserving {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} spawned by ''{{ai|Rampant Growth|Zyra}}'' over {{as|Seeds|buzzword2}} spawned by ''Garden of Thorns''.
|effect radius= 900
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self
|spelleffects = 
|notes        = 
* {{Pending for test}}: The pattern/probability of ''Garden of Thorns'' spawning one seed or two.
* '''Zyra''' tries to plant {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} in brush and not on top of walls.
* '''Zyra''' tries not to plant {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} too close together and at different angles.
* '''Zyra''' does not plant any {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} if she is concealed within a brush (unless there is an enemy ward in it, in which case it takes her a little longer to plant the {{as|Seed|buzzword}}) or when there is no room for additional ones.
* '''Zyra''' does not plant any {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} if she is within {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 1400 units of the coordinate points (400, 400) or (14000, 14000), which are roughly at the center of the fountains on {{tip|Summoner's Rift}}.
** These same coordinates may not hold as fountain positions on other maps (e.g. on the {{tip|Arena}} map, the Magma Chamber area overlaps with the second exclusion radius) and may prompt the implementation of this behaviour to be changed in the future.{{bug}}
* '''Zyra''' tries to plant {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} close to an enemy near her.
* {{Pending for test}}: '''Zyra''' tries to plant {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} under enemy structures only if she is in basic attack range of them.
* {{Pending for test}}: '''Zyra''' tries to plant {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} on the other side of the wall she is facing and/or standing right next to.
* {{Pending for test}}: '''Zyra''' tries to plant {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} in the direction she is facing and/or moving.
* '''Zyra''' tries to plant {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} near jungle path entrances.
* {{Pending for test}}: '''Zyra''' tries to plant {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} behind herself when she is walking through the river and there are no jungle path entrances near her.
* '''Zyra''' tries to plant {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} between herself and the enemy champion she has vision of (or is heading towards her) in a 45º angle to the left or to the right depending on where on lane she is standing.
* '''Zyra''' tries to plant {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} against the inner walls of epic monster pits ({{ui|Dragon}}, {{ui|Rift Herald}}, {{ui|Baron Nashor}})
* '''Zyra''' has a hidden passive that grants her 10% increased {{tip|size}} for {{tt|33 seconds|Estimated}} after having {{cai|Sunlight|Leona}} applied to her.
}}
